# Wrapbook

> > Production payroll, accounting, and workforce management platform for the entertainment industry.

Wrapbook provides modern software solutions for production payroll, crew onboarding, labor compliance, and financial management across film, television, commercials, and unscripted content. The platform serves production companies, accountants, and crew members with tools for managing complex entertainment industry workflows, compliance requirements, and payment processing.

## Key Topics

- Production Payroll
- Production Accounting
- Labor Compliance
- Crew Management
- Entertainment Industry
- Film Production
- Unscripted Entertainment
- Minimum Wage & Overtime Laws
- Room Tone Community

## Labor Compliance & Regulations

- [2026 Minimum Wage & Overtime Laws by State](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/complete-list-overtime-laws-by-state): State-by-state breakdown of 2026 minimum wage and overtime regulations
- [AB 2257 & How It Affects Freelance Photographers](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/ab-2257): California AB 2257 impact on freelance photographer classification
- [How to Conduct Background Checks: A Guide for Production Pros](https://www.wrapbook.com/blog/how-to-conduct-background-checks-a-guide-for-production-pros): Production background check guide for crew and vendor screening
